title: Vittoria Gonzaga, nun at Santa Chiara, Naples, to her brother, 1686-91 (catalogue 1570): number passages read in part

steps.what: Number passages of cc. 3v, 4r, 11r, 20r, 22r, 23r, 21r transcribed at about 1400 px.
Table built by WAINUT's AI language-model agents, without a solver, from cc. 3v and 4r using word divisions and context; swapped-pair pattern noticed.

Independent blind check: 57 groups, 5 disagreements, 8.8%, all resolved on zoom, none against the solver; -10.452 against shuffled mean -15.147, best -13.197. Annealing with no key recovered 11 of 18 letter values.
All number lines of cc. 20r, 21r, 22v transcribed from native-size tiles, key known; 21 changes logged.
Reading rebuilt from a marked source and checked by script.
One web search found no edition.

Decrypt audit (research/decrypt_audit): the script found 92 of 239 compared words of reading_numbers.md departing from key.tsv applied to transcription_numbers.txt. Checked with an own read-only snippet: key.tsv gives decryption_numbers.txt in 37 of 37 lines; reading_numbers.md is edit_numbers.txt with its marks removed; the 795 letters given inside the number passages are the 795 letters of the decrypt; the departing words are clear words of the letters and the 22 bracketed proposals and unread words. Unmarked emendations: 0. No key value was missing; no file but NOTES.md and this profile changed. No image compared.

Matthew Kennedy (PR #853, kennedy_2026/): all four letters transcribed again, with the lower half of c. 4r (lines L1_4r_13 to L1_4r_24b, about 70 cipher words) that the transcription of 3 Nov did not have. 267 cipher words and 2 clear numerals (1000 on c. 11r, 50 on c. 21r). He had WAINUT's key and reading. Checked by him against native-size Estense crops, by his statement.

Matthew Kennedy: key_kennedy.tsv (the swapped-pair alphabet, 3 = z, dot-marked 5 = b, values from context for the codes 159 per, 109 Duca, 182 V.E., 13 et) and a reading of all four letters that fills the doubtful and unread words of 3 Nov (stamo disperate, secutorio, Spagna, abbatte, tutti pollicinelli, uscire, il vescovo lo voleva carcerare, the summons for 1,000 ducats on c. 11r). First count 266 of 267, which took expanded abbreviations and context codes as read.

Matthew Kennedy, verify_vittoria_gonzaga.py: every one of the 269 entries tokenises one way and re-encodes exactly; a blind anneal on Letter 1 alone, with no crib, agrees with the key on 381 of 397 held-out letter tokens of Letters 2-4; random-key trials give Z between 6.08 and 6.84 (quadgrams) and 9.44 to 14.44 (lexicon). The Italian model inputs are his own bundled files. Rerun by the review of PR #853 in a scratch copy: same figures.

Reading review for the maintainers by Codex (kennedy_2026/NOTES.md, Reading review): the four Italian readings read with their translations, the Estense images sampled at 1,200 px; grades B, A, B, A for the letters of 1686, 1688, 4 Sept 1691 and 16 Oct 1691. Given before the decryption files were made literal.

Matthew Kennedy, after the maintainers' review: recount by the sure-word rule, 237 of 267 cipher words (88.8%), 30 holes (24 words with supplied letters or a dittography, 5 code words taken from context on one or two uses, 1 doubtful word); the decryption files made the literal output of key_kennedy.tsv (renditz, spesz, mz, z, and i for the 50 before carre); Remaining gaps and Escalation written; the model named.

Integration of PR #853 (AI agent, for the maintainers; not a person). The review of the pull request had recounted the holes from the four reading files (14, 4, 5, 7 = 30) and rebuilt decryption_full.txt on all 55 lines with its own decoder from key_kennedy.tsv and transcription_full.txt. Carried into this profile and NOTES.md: fraction read 0.888, the five gaps (the blocker of the 24 expanded words relabelled from no-key-material to too-short: writer's abbreviations, not a missing key), the escalation, the transcription doubts, both key files without choosing between 13 et and 15 d' on c. 20r, the credit. The four readings read as sentences with the translation and reading_review grade B recorded on each. No image opened; docs/_validate.py not run; no page.

Stopping-point check before a write-up (AI agent for the maintainers, Claude Fable 5.2; not a person). The two transcriptions compared group by group on the passages both have (own read-only script): 776 of the 808 groups of transcription_numbers.txt stand in kennedy_2026/transcription_full.txt in the same order; 30 places differ, most of them words that the first reading at about 1,400 px left as no word. Eight places looked at on native-size crops of the Estense IIIF images. c. 20r l. 2: the group between danno and interesse is 13, not 15; a doubling stroke stands over the 55 of danno; di (15 50), not da, before 182. c. 4r l. 7: the fourth group is 60, so anima, not ansia. c. 23r l. 2: the unread group ends in 85 and begins with 1 or 4 (det or let, no word). c. 21r: the last sign of vuol is faint and can be 45 or 85; after carre the crop has 15 10, da; the group before 35 7 (ho) is under a blot. Count on the four letters unchanged at 237 of 267: danno is written in full (one hole closed), the word under the blot is a hole (one opened). The contributors' files were not edited.

Siblings (same agent). On main no target has this shelfmark or key; guastalla1717 is another cipher. The Lodovico catalogue searched by shelfmark: 18 records for the dossier, cc. 1-33, four of them described as partly in cipher. The twelve other records of 1687 and later (46 page images) viewed at 780 px. cc. 24v-25r, the letter of 18 Sept 1691 (record eab58d9b-6ca2-44c8-bc90-eb88a5c05fb0), has a short run of numbers and about 15 lines of them; the record does not say so and neither contributor transcribed it. No number passage seen on the other eleven at that size; a single group inside clear text could be missed.

Sample of c. 24v on six native-size crops, read with the letter values common to both keys (same agent): 'non so Monsig.re come la sentira', and the block opens '[?ho] levato il foglio [?in] cifra dalla l.ra nel 171 109 13 e il seguente'. The same cipher. 171, 109 and 13 are on a native-size crop; 104, 159, 182 and 161, 162, 165, 168 were seen at reduced size only. The clear text of the page names 'S.r Duca di Torre Mag.e', which supports Duca for 109 on c. 21r and does not prove it; et does not fit 13 before 'e il' as it stands. A look, not a transcription: nothing was transcribed, decrypted or counted, and no file was made. Outcome of the check: the target is not at a stopping point; no page was written. Next: transcribe and decrypt cc. 24v-25r, test the code values on it, recount.

Letter of 18 Sept 1691, cc. 24v-25r (AI agent for the maintainers, Claude Opus 5.5; not a person; it knew the key): the run of two lines and the block of twelve lines with one run-over on c. 24v and the three lines of c. 25r transcribed from native-size Estense regions (the earlier agent's tiles of 24 Nov, re-checked here, and new regions), two passes per line at different cut points and enlargements. transcription_cc24v-25r.txt: 603 groups, 34 distinct, 155 cipher words (docs/_check_profile.py --measure). The passes differed at about a dozen places (pensare against penetrare, 162 against 182, an extra 20 10 in one word, altro read without its 75, tempo with a doubled 60, vive with 80); each was settled on a further enlargement, and two passes cannot be called independent, since one reader made both.

c. 3v, svegl[i]ati (same agent): a native-size region of the line. The ink has 90 2 30 40 45 10 85 50, with no 50 between 45 and 10 (the 1 of 10 carries a dot); Kennedy's doubt line is right and his transcription_full.txt, which has the 50, is not. The word stays a hole. The contributor's file was not edited.

kennedy_2026/key_kennedy.tsv applied to the new transcription by scripts/decode_cc24v-25r.py, nothing edited (decryption_cc24v-25r.txt), then read as sentences (reading_cc24v-25r.md, translation_cc24v-25r.md). Every letter value of the key gives Italian with no change: she took the cipher sheet out of the letter of the Duke of Torre Maggiore and copies it; the Duke will wait for October to load the grain when the boats come; this blessed plague, no one knows what it is; in the province of Bari they die of hunger; time will reveal it. Holes: seven abbreviations or a word-final 3, two words where a clear group gives no word (ricausranno, bcri), and nine uses of eight code groups with no sure value.

Code values tested at every place in the five letters (key_additions_2026-11-24.tsv). Taken as sure: 159 per (five places in three letters, four of them per before an infinitive), 13 et (three places: danno et interesse, et e il seguente, et io aspettaro), 182 V.E. (three places, a person each time, V.E. the address of the clear text of both letters), 109 Duca (two places, both the Duke of Torre Maggiore, named in the clear text of c. 24v). Kept probable: 171 Signor (one place, before Duca), 161 questo (two places that other words fit). No value: 165, 185, 162, 168, 160, 200 (one place each). WAINUT's d' for the group on c. 20r fails: the group is 13 at all three places.

Lodovico keyword searches (Sangro Paolo, Torremaggiore, Torre Maggiore) for the Duke's own letters in the Campori collection, which might carry the same cipher: each returned one unrelated record. Nothing found; not pursued further.

Recount by the sure-word rule over the five letters, scripts/count_words.py (cipher words from the transcription files, holes from the reading files, the two adjustments of the image check of 24 Nov on Letter 4). With only 104 sure: Letters 1-4 237 of 267 (the figure carried), Letter 5 129 of 155. With 104, 159, 13, 182 and 109 sure: Letter 1 141 of 155, Letter 2 12 of 15, Letter 3 19 of 24, Letter 4 70 of 73 (95.9%), Letter 5 137 of 155 (88.4%); all five 379 of 422, 43 holes, 89.8%. Read in part. Every hole has an outside blocker (the writer's abbreviations and slips, a blot, a three-letter word, code groups that stand once or twice with no key sheet), so the target is at a stopping point. Letter 5's reading was not graded by its author; its second reader came later the same day (below).

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 1631 tokens, 26 types, it-cinquecento order 4: reading -2.036 per letter; random keys -5.16 (z 5.9); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.244 (mean -3.272, z 64.2); annealer on the real text -2.036. Verdict: pass.

Second reader of the letter of 18 Sept 1691 and claims review of the page (an AI agent for the maintainers, not the agent that made the reading; not a person; scripts outside the repository). Its own decoder from kennedy_2026/key_kennedy.tsv gives decryption_cc24v-25r.txt on all 18 lines (603 groups, 155 cipher words). The reading was read as Italian sentences against the decode and the English; every departure from the key output is marked except the word division sene > se ne (twice), now stated in the reading file's header. Code grades agreed (104, 159, 13, 182, 109 sure; 171, 161 probable). Eight places on cc. 24v and 25r compared with the Estense images: all as transcribed. Grade B recorded as the letter's reading_review. Found on c. 4r (Letter 1, L1_4r_20): a hooked stroke over the 55 of an[n]i, as Kennedy's note records ('ink macron over 55'), the stroke that made danno a sure word on c. 20r.

Recount with anni counted sure (scripts/count_words.py, the adjustment added beside the two of Letter 4): Letter 1 142 of 155 (91.6%, 13 holes); all five 380 of 422, 42 holes, 90.0%. Letters 2-5 unchanged. Read in part, unchanged: Letter 4 alone is over 95%. The page, the ledgers and NOTES.md were corrected from the claims review: WAINUT's key built by WAINUT's AI agents (PR #226, the first to recover it), the differences between the two keys on the code values, Kennedy's statement that he checked his transcription against the scans, and that no maintainer or outside person has checked any transcription.

Holes by the sure-word rule (README Conventions, 19 Nov 2026) however plain the word is; nothing outside the letters can add what she did not write. The contributor's statement; not looked at in the check of 24 Nov 2026. Clear text, outside the count of holes. The cipher word anima against ansia (c. 4r), listed here until 24 Nov 2026, is settled on the image: anima.

texts.label: Number passages, cc. 3v-23r (WAINUT, 3 Nov 2026; without the lower half of c. 4r)
texts.summary: Estate and grain business from a convent in Naples: the sequestration of San Paolo by Don Paolo Ruffo, and a request for licensed grain that she turned aside because the Camera held the licences for the State of Milan.
texts.note: Number words 198: as sense 172 (86.9%), no restored or changed letter 172 (86.9%), 17 doubtful, 9 not read.

reading_review.by: AI language-model agent (for WAINUT; a model reading, not a person), independent of the solver
reading_review.note: Read as sentences 3 Nov 2026. Most passages read as Italian sentences and match the English: the San Paolo sequestration by Paolo Ruffo, 'Per amor di Dio... fidarci di nessuno', c. 20r on the loading, and above all c. 21r on the Torre Maggiore grain licences held by the Camera for Milan. About a third of the sentences have holes, and they are clustered rather than scattered: c. 3v has several weak guesses (stcmo/sperate, seculnorio->sequestratore, spaltta->Spagna, banatte unread, 'Mog.' wives line muddled), c. 4r opens with 'lutti pollici nelli' and 'uocire' unread, c. 11r is a fragment that does not make sense, c. 22r and the last line of c. 23r ('preceti') are unclear, and two code groups ([109], [182]) are unidentified.

texts.label: Letter of 2 April 1686, cc. 3v-4r (Matthew Kennedy, 21-23 Nov 2026)
texts.summary: The two nuns to their brother: Don Paolo Ruffo means to lift the sequestration of San Paolo and they fear a sale of the goods; the Marquis of Casale Nuovo is seeking a writ of execution in the Vicaria; the only remedy is a safeguard from Spain; at the Collaterale no one can be trusted. Then praise of a young gentleman from Rome who has no crust of bread assigned to him, and his prayer for the birth of a little prince.
texts.note: Matthew Kennedy, PR #853 (21-23 Nov 2026), key kennedy_2026/key_kennedy.tsv. 155 cipher words, 14 holes by the strict count (kennedy_2026/NOTES.md; recounted by the review of the pull request), 13 since the second reader of 24 Nov 2026: an[n]i (c. 4r, L1_4r_20) has a doubling stroke over its 55 (Kennedy's own note: 'ink macron over 55'; the stroke is on the image), the stroke that made danno a sure word on c. 20r, so scripts/count_words.py counts it sure. The reading file, which prints an[n]i, was not edited. The clear text is in italics in the reading file.

reading_review.by: integration review of PR #853 (AI agent, for the maintainers); not a person
reading_review.note: Read as sentences with the English beside it, 24 Nov 2026: the number passages complete the clear sentences around them throughout (the sequestration, the safeguard of Spain, fidarci di nessuno, the gentleman of Rome). Two places do not read smoothly: 'ha tenut[o] V.E. di tal materia' on c. 3v, where the English supplies 'us unaware', and 's[i] presto senta la nascita' on c. 4r. Grade B: 13 words carry supplied letters. Codex's review of 22 Nov 2026 for the maintainers (kennedy_2026/NOTES.md) predates the literal decryption. No image opened.

texts.label: Letter of 16 October 1691, cc. 20r and 21r (Matthew Kennedy, 21-23 Nov 2026)

texts.label: Letter of 18 September 1691, cc. 24v-25r (24 Nov 2026)
texts.summary: She has taken the cipher sheet out of a letter of the Duke of Torre Maggiore and copies it: the Duke will wait for October to load the grain when the boats come, and adds that no one knows what this blessed plague is, that in the province of Bari they die of hunger, and that time will reveal it. A two-line run in the clear text before it says she does not know how Monsignore will take it.
texts.note: Transcribed, decrypted with kennedy_2026/key_kennedy.tsv and read by an AI agent for the maintainers (Claude Opus 5.5), 24 Nov 2026; not a person. 155 cipher words, 18 holes by the sure-word rule (scripts/count_words.py): seven words with supplied letters (Monsig[nor]e, l[ette]ra, esec[u]t[ion]e, carricam[ent]o, dic[e], negot[i]o, rovin[a]to), two words where a clear group gives no word (ricausranno, bcri), and nine uses of the eight code groups with no sure value. Codes graded sure in key_additions_2026-11-24.tsv are counted as read. The author of the reading did not grade it; a second reader, another AI agent and not a person, read it the same day and gave grade B (reading_review below). The clear text is in italics in the reading file and only the words next to the cipher are given.

reading_review.by: integration review of 24 Nov 2026 (AI agent, for the maintainers); not a person
reading_review.note: Second reader, not the agent that made the reading. An own decoder from kennedy_2026/key_kennedy.tsv (.5. taken as 5 = b) applied to transcription_cc24v-25r.txt gives decryption_cc24v-25r.txt on all 18 lines (603 groups, 155 cipher words). The reading was read as Italian sentences against the decode and the English: every departure from the key output is marked (seven abbreviations or a final bare 3, ricausranno and bcri, the probable and unvalued codes), except the word division sene > se ne (twice), which the header does not state. 18 holes, 137 of 155 sure (88.4%). Code grades agreed: 104, 159, 13, 182 and 109 sure (for 182 the clear V.E. of cc. 21r and 24v speaks against V.S.), 171 and 161 probable. Eight places compared with the Estense images (c. 24v ll. 3-6, 8, 10, 13; c. 25r l. 2): all as transcribed; del and aspettaro rest on the decode where the 4/8 forms break the hand's habit, as the doubts list says. The sentences cohere: the Duke's sheet on waiting for October to load the grain, the plague, hunger at Bari, 'il tempo lo scoprira'. Not smooth where two open codes stand together ([200] sento [165]; [185] [162]; [?questo] [168]) and in 'hanno altro male che la fame', which wants a negative the cipher does not have. Grade B.
